s1.description: The problem: brain shift makes the surgeon’s map wrong, and noisy ultrasound makes it hard to fix.

s2.description: The solution: keep only the matches that agree, then check the result.

s3.description: Quantum rationale: the trust decision is a max-clique QUBO; honest about today’s limits.

s4.description: Technical implementation in Qiskit, and the live app.

s5.description: Results: benchmark on 22 patients, the confidence alarm, and real IBM hardware with noise analysis.

s6.description: Outlook: when quantum would win, what is new, and the limits.
